episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: After a Qing-mandated exile, Grand Prince Jinhan returns to a hostile palace. He later encounters an intriguing baduk player who proves to be elusive.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After facing Yi In in a game of baduk, Kang Hee-soo develops feelings for him. Meanwhile, Yi Seon grows increasingly ill, creating a succession crisis.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Kim Myung-ha urges Hee-soo to stop her ruse. When a royal crisis arises, Kang Hang-soon performs a selfless act — but Kim Jong-bae schemes against Yi In.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: After a confrontation with Yi Seon, Yi In ascends to the throne — but not without opposition. In the process, he cruelly turns a blind eye to Hee-soo.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Yi In summons Myung-ha to the palace and appoints him to a special role. To get the attention of the king, Hee-soo takes part in the baduk examination.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Hee-soo receives a stern warning from Yi In upon becoming his official baduk companion, later becoming entangled in a political ploy by the queen dowager.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Yi In begins to suspect a suspicious relationship between Myung-ha and Hee-soo. Later, Hee-soo joins the Grand Prince on a royal trip with the King.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: After rumors of Yi In's affection toward Hee-soo spread like wildfire, the palace arranges a royal night of intimacy for him — despite true feelings.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: After a night of intimacy, Yi In and Hee-soo navigate their complicated feelings. In an attempt to oust Hee-soo, Park Jong-hwan wages a bet with Yi In.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: The Qing makes a contentious demand, and Yi In's decision in the matter forces Hee-soo to carry out her own plan — but last-minute complications arise.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: As Jong-hwan gets close to catching the faux-princess, Hee-soo puts her faith in Yi In — struggling with her growing feelings for him.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: After lightning ignites a fire, Yi In sees it as a sign from above. As Queen Oh's health falters, Hee-soo strives to protect the Grand Prince's fate.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: A last-minute change of heart gravely injures Hee-soo — prompting questions around her gender. Later, Yi In reveals the fate of her father to her.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: In a vulnerable moment, Lee In shares the secret of his ascension with Hee Soo. Jong Hwan plans a counterattack for Lee In's investigation of past events.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: After Senior Court Lady Dong's tragedy, Lee In aims to punish the one responsible. Queen Dowager Park finally learns the truth about Hee Soo's gender.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Despite Yi In's opposition, Hee-soo embarks on a dangerous journey to visit her father. But as months pass, their reunion remains uncertain.
